pkgmetadata.longdescription: Rustinion agent (device management and monitoring). The release ebuild installs the very binaries the signed .deb ships (unpacked from the apt repo's package, hash-pinned by the Manifest); the 9999 ebuild builds the agent and the remote-access helper from source.

use.flag: Install the remote-access helper (/usr/libexec/rustinion/rustinion-ra-host[-pw]) when the package ships it
